name: Mahou Senshi - memory of gray
original_name: 魔法戦士　memory of gray
source:
Emeroad Fine and Emeroad Misty caught up to Kiel who plans to rule the world and engaged in a combat. During the battle, a mysterious monster appeared and attacked the three of them.

When Fine and Misty were swallowed by the light emitted by the monster, they found themselves in another world. There, they meet a boy with gray hair. The boy's name is "Kiel".

What is the identity of the boy? And what is the goal of the mysterious monster?

[Translated from [url=http://www.route2.co.jp/Triangle/Products/SK-CD7/index.html#section-MemoryOfGray]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
艾默罗德·法恩和艾默罗德·米斯蒂追上了计划统治世界的基尔，并展开了战斗。战斗中，一只神秘怪物出现，袭击了三人。

当Fine和Misty被怪物发出的光芒吞噬时，他们发现自己来到了另一个世界。在那里，他们遇到了一个头发花白的男孩。这个男孩的名字叫“基尔”。

男孩的身份是什么？而神秘怪物的目的又是什么？

[翻译自[url=http://www.route2.co.jp/Triangle/Products/SK-CD7/index.html#section-MemoryOfGray]官方网站[/url]]
